policies.with_check: (maskan_can_create_active_cycle(network_id, cycle_number) AND (status = 'active'::text) AND (closed_at IS NULL) AND ((requested_by_member_id IS NULL) OR (requested_by_member_id = maskan_current_member_id())))

(maskan_is_network_member(network_id) AND (member_id = maskan_current_member_id()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM expense_reset_requests request
  WHERE ((request.id = expense_reset_approvals.reset_request_id) AND (request.network_id = expense_reset_approvals.network_id)))))

(maskan_is_network_member(network_id) AND (requested_by_member_id = maskan_current_member_id()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM expense_cycles target_cycle
  WHERE ((target_cycle.id = expense_reset_requests.cycle_id) AND (target_cycle.network_id = expense_reset_requests.network_id)))))

(maskan_is_network_member(network_id) AND (added_by_member_id = maskan_current_member_id()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM network_members payer
  WHERE ((payer.id = expenses.paid_by_member_id) AND (payer.network_id = expenses.network_id)))) AND ((cycle_id IS NULL) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM expense_cycles target_cycle
  WHERE ((target_cycle.id = expenses.cycle_id) AND (target_cycle.network_id = expenses.network_id))))))

((added_by_member_id = maskan_current_member_id()) AND ((paid_by_member_id IS NULL) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM network_members payer
  WHERE ((payer.id = expenses.paid_by_member_id) AND (payer.network_id = expenses.network_id))))) AND ((cycle_id IS NULL) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM expense_cycles target_cycle
  WHERE ((target_cycle.id = expenses.cycle_id) AND (target_cycle.network_id = expenses.network_id))))))

(maskan_is_network_member(network_id) AND ((actor_member_id = maskan_current_member_id()) OR ((actor_member_id IS NULL) AND (kind = 'cycle_started'::text))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM network_members recipient
  WHERE ((recipient.id = network_notifications.recipient_member_id) AND (recipient.network_id = network_notifications.network_id)))) AND ((expense_id IS NULL) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM expenses expense
  WHERE ((expense.id = network_notifications.expense_id) AND (expense.network_id = network_notifications.network_id))))) AND ((reset_request_id IS NULL) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM expense_reset_requests request
  WHERE ((request.id = network_notifications.reset_request_id) AND (request.network_id = network_notifications.network_id))))))
